subject: Genetics
title: The Political Battle
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Political Battle.

hook.text: James Watson championed the project. Critics called it 'big science' that would drain funding from real labs.

buildup.text: Small-lab biologists feared the project would centralize funding and power, killing independent research.

discovery.text: Watson lobbied Congress personally. He compared it to the Manhattan Project—massive but transformative.

twist.text: Watson resigned as project head in 1992 over patent disputes. The politics were nearly as complex as the DNA.

climax.text: Francis Collins replaced him and steered the project to completion. Leadership mattered as much as science.

punchline.text: The hardest part wasn't the DNA. It was the politics.

quiz.question: Who replaced James Watson as head of the Human Genome Project?
